It’s time for an almighty American muscle head-to-head!

We’ve got our hands on the legendary Corvette Z06, and it’s going up against the Ford Mustang Dark Horse and the literal king of the strip—the Dodge Demon! This is the ultimate battle for US supremacy, but who will cross the line first? Let’s check out the stats…

Starting with the Corvette Z06, it’s powered by a 5.5-litre naturally aspirated LT6 V8 with a flat-plane crank, generating 670hp and 625Nm. Power is sent to the rear wheels via an 8-speed dual-clutch transmission, and it tips the scales at 1,685kg. In today’s market, you’re looking at around £88,000 to get your hands on one of these mid-engine
